newsitem.title: USA: Trigon says cutting jobs in reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Trigon says cutting jobs in reorganization.

text.p: Trigon Insurance Co, an independent licensee for the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association, said Friday it is cutting three percent of its workforce as part of a re-organization and re-engineering of its member services division.
The company said it will now automate the routine claims process for its nearly 1.9 million members.
In a statement, Trigon said 16 full-time and four part-time employees, out of 663 employees, will lose their jobs.
The company added that 52 vacant positions will be eliminated.
Trigon said affected full-time employees will receive severance pay and extended benefits, and both full and part-time employees will receive outplacement services.
